t: This is a drinking fountain in Pimlico, on the east side of the junction with Avery Farm Row. It commemorates Richard Grosvenor, the 2nd Marquess of Westminster, who was a politician, landowner, property developer and benefactor. That last role suits a public fountain. It was designed by Thomas Henry Wyatt, an architect with a long and distinguished career. He was president of the Royal Institute of British Architects from 1870 to 1873, and he received its Royal Gold Medal in 1873.
